script.problem: It reuses a line from the Prep cards word for word.

terra.problem: The last sentence claims the expression “I've been around” comes from Satan's words. The text doesn't establish that.
“That word” follows the mention of joy, suggesting joy returns a few verses later. Integrity is the word that returns.
Satan predicts that Job will curse God, not that any man will do so when suffering becomes personal.
“They don't know him right away at all” goes beyond the text, which says they could barely recognize him.
“They don't hold anything back” claims more about the friends' response than the text says.
Calling their sorrow quiet conflicts with the text's description of them weeping aloud.
The joke about being unable to sit still trivializes the friends' response to Job's intense suffering.
“No one spoke” broadens the text's statement that no one spoke a word to Job.
